A contemporary urban hotel for the discerning business or leisure traveler, located in one of Hanoi's fastest developing districts. Only a few minutes from the National Convention Center, the National Museum, My Dinh sport complex. Approximately 40 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport, 20 minutes to down town and a short walk to the Van Phuc Silk Village. The hotel also offers guests a well-equipped fitness centre including a spa, sauna and an indoor heated pool.
